kernelsu.notes: Official KernelSU. SUSFS is the gki-android12-5.10 kernel patch plus 10_enable_susfs_for_ksu.patch from the same commit.

kernelsu-next.notes: Official dev first. If that tree still has no KSU_SUSFS and the official patch does not apply, fall back to pershoot dev-susfs.

sukisu-nova.notes: SUSFS builds check out the builtin branch, which already carries manager-side KSU_SUSFS.

kowsu.susfs_blocked: The official SUSFS manager patch does not apply to this fork: it changes sucompat.c, allowlist.c, boot_event.c and the supercall files that the patch edits. Use enable_susfs=false or another manager.
kowsu.notes: KOWX712's KernelSU fork (official KernelSU plus its own commits). Builds without SUSFS; SUSFS is blocked until a fork-specific patch exists.

bakasu.notes: Official main already contains manager-side KSU_SUSFS.
